views.title: The Land of Oz
views.attribution: Drawn for Fable after L. Frank Baum (tools/draw_map.py)

places.name: Kansas
places.note: Dorothy's home on the great gray prairies, with Uncle Henry and Aunt Em.

places.name: Great desert
places.note: The desert that surrounds the Land of Oz; none could live to cross it.

places.name: Land of the North
places.note: Home of the Good Witch of the North.

places.name: Land of the Munchkins
places.note: The country in the East where Dorothy's house comes down; blue is the Munchkins' colour.

places.name: Road of yellow brick
places.note: The road that leads to the Emerald City.

places.name: The cornfield
places.note: A great cornfield beside the road, where a Scarecrow is set up on a pole.

places.name: Great forest
places.label: The Great Forest
places.note: A forest where the trees grow so close together that their branches meet over the road.

places.name: Little cottage
places.label: The Cottage
places.note: A cottage of logs and branches in the forest beside the road.

places.name: Great ditch
places.label: The Great Ditch
places.note: A great ditch across the road through the forest.

places.name: Broad river
places.label: The River
places.note: A broad, swift river across the travellers' way.

places.name: Poppy field
places.label: The Poppy Field
places.note: A great meadow of scarlet poppies beside the river.

places.name: Emerald City
places.label: The Emerald City
places.note: The city of Oz, the Great Wizard, where everything is green.

places.name: Country of the Winkies
places.note: The West, ruled by the Wicked Witch; yellow is the Winkies' colour.

places.name: Yellow Castle
places.label: The Yellow Castle
places.note: The castle of the Winkies, in the Land of the West.

places.name: Country of the Quadlings
places.note: The South, where red is the colour.

places.name: China country
places.label: The China Country
places.note: A country walled in white china, where everything is made of china.

places.name: Grand old forest
places.label: The Grand Old Forest
places.note: A forest beyond the china country, where the beasts are in need of a King.

places.name: Hill of the Hammer-Heads
places.note: A rocky hill guarded by the armless Hammer-Heads.

places.name: Castle of Glinda
places.label: The Castle of Glinda
places.note: The castle of Glinda, the Good Witch of the South.
